content.text:
I submitted index 28 (Sb 0.67, Y 0.33) as the best, but the whole library looks inactive under 2.4 eV light. All three EQE values were essentially zero and slightly negative, so the choice between them means little.

| Index | Sb fraction | Target phase | Why I chose it | Measured EQE |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 23 | 0.52 | YSbO4 | Stable; lowest predicted gap of the stable mixed phases (about 3.0 eV) | −0.00041% |
| 28 | 0.67 | Sb-rich end | Sb6O13 predicted gap about 2.05 eV, the only phase below 2.4 eV | −0.00035% |
| 14 | 0.24 | Y3SbO7 | Stable; last unexplored region (gap about 3.6 eV) | −0.00079% |

- **Why it's likely inactive:** the Sb–Y oxides predicted to be stable all have gaps above the 2.4 eV photon energy, so they shouldn't absorb the light.
- **Phases I set aside:** the only small-gap Sb–Y oxides (0.1–0.34 eV) are structures predicted to be unstable, so they're unlikely to have formed in the films.
- **Not explored:** I used none of the 5 XRD measurements, so I never confirmed which phases the films actually contain. Compositions with Sb below 0.24 were never measured, including pure Y2O3, which has an even wider gap.
- **Limit of the score:** since every measured value is effectively zero, the result depends entirely on whether some unmeasured composition was active. With 3 of 29 measured, I can't rule that out.
